import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long inf = 100000000000000000L;
    static final int max_n = 1001;
    static int[] xdir = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] ydir = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] gr = new ArrayList[max_n];
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[max_n];
    static int[] pa = new int[max_n];

    static boolean is_valid(int x, int y, String[] s) {
        int n = s.length;
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && s[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && s[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static int[][] perform_bfs(int start_x, int start_y, String[] s) {
        int n = s.length;
        int[][] dist = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : dist) Arrays.fill(row, (int) inf);
        dist[start_x][start_y] = 0;
        Deque<int[]> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        queue.offer(new int[]{start_x, start_y});
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] current = queue.pollFirst();
            int cx = current[0], cy = current[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = cx + xdir[i];
                int ny = cy + ydir[i];
                if (!is_valid(nx, ny, s) || dist[nx][ny] != (int) inf) continue;
                dist[nx][ny] = dist[cx][cy] + 1;
                queue.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
        return dist;
    }

    static void read_input(Scanner sc) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        String[] s1 = new String[n];
        String[] s2 = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s1[i] = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) s2[i] = sc.next();

        int rx = -1, ry = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (s1[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] reac_dist = perform_bfs(rx, ry, s1);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!is_valid(i, j, s1)) continue;
                int[][] from_cell = perform_bfs(i, j, s1);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                        if (!is_valid(x, y, s1) || from_cell[x][y] > t || from_cell[x][y] > reac_dist[x][y]) continue;
                        if (from_cell[x][y] == reac_dist[x][y]) {
                            boolean can_move = false;
                            for (int dir_idx = 0; dir_idx < 4; dir_idx++) {
                                int xto = x + xdir[dir_idx];
                                int yto = y + ydir[dir_idx];
                                if (!is_valid(xto, yto, s1) || from_cell[xto][yto] >= reac_dist[xto][yto]) continue;
                                can_move = true;
                            }
                            if (!can_move) continue;
                        }
                        int max_num1 = s1[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                        int max_num2 = s2[x][y] - '0';
                        for (int num1 = 1; num1 <= max_num1; num1++) {
                            for (int num2 = 1; num2 <= max_num2; num2++) {
                                int v1 = 10 * (j + i * 10) + num1;
                                int v2 = 10 * (y + 10 * x) + num2;
                                gr[v1].add(v2);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean try_match(int v) {
        if (used[v]) return false;
        used[v] = true;
        for (int to : gr[v]) {
            if (pa[to] == 0 || try_match(pa[to])) {
                pa[to] = v;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (int i = 0; i < max_n; i++) {
            gr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        read_input(sc);
        int total_nodes = max_n;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(used, false);
            try_match(i);
        }
        int match_count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            if (pa[i] != 0) match_count++;
        }
        System.out.println(match_count);
        sc.close();
    }
}
